name: brokk-observe
description: Audit trail for Codex: ships every session's prompts, tool calls, commits and PRs to your Brokk Observe server for security review, leaderboards and bug attribution.

interface.shortDescription: Records your Codex sessions for your organization's audit trail
interface.longDescription: Sends each session's prompts, tool calls, commits and PRs to your organization's Brokk Observe server, which reviews them for security problems and can apply central guardrail policies before a tool call runs.
